items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: You know, we used to steal people in those days. And he says, 'Well, you've got to get Dodo Marmarosa on piano,' and I said, 'Okay, we'll get Dodo,' when the piano thing came open.

ctx.x: Eddie Burt was in that band and Dodo Marmarosa and -- and the two bass players, Chubby and -- oh, there was Oscar there, too. It was quite an engagement. A far cry from the band that was in there in '34.
